notes: Posted 2 August 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
Starting cards as posted under 'start3': Tatooine: Slave Quarters, Tatooine: Cantina and Careful Planning (no Objective); these count toward the total.

'Twix' is player slang for a site with two Light Force icons and none for the opponent. Posted 'hoth twix', 'endor twix', 'dagobah twix' and 'home one twix' dested the only 2/0 Light sites of the era on those planets: Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room), Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut, Dagobah: Yoda's Hut and Home One: War Room. 'yavin 4 twix' is kept as written: Yavin 4: Massassi Headquarters, Massassi Ruins and Massassi War Room are all 2/0 Light sites, so the card can't be told.

Posted 'slave qutars' dested Tatooine: Slave Quarters; 'cantina' the Light Tatooine: Cantina; 'tatooine obis hut' Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut; 'dont get @#$%ey' Don't Get Cocky; 'nubrn leads' Nabrun Leids.

Posted 'Chewie w/ gun', 'leia w/ gun', 'han w/ gun', 'obi w/ saber' and 'lano w/ ax' dested Chewie With Blaster Rifle, Leia With Blaster Rifle, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, Obi-Wan With Lightsaber and Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'naked 3-po' Threepio With His Parts Showing.

The section 'Ohter18' holds only the line 'all just 7s use the ones u got and whant' (18 unnamed destiny-7 cards of the player's choice); it is kept as one text row of 18. With it the list totals 60; the 42 named cards total 42.
